notes.title: Hive Update #13 - Honeycomb arrives November 6, 2025
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Explorers![/h1][p][/p][p]Today we come to you with a bunch of highly anticipated news and trust me when I say that we’re as much excited as you are for this! [/p][p][/p][h2][b]Let’s start with a bang![/b][/h2][p]We’ve prepared a new trailer just for you! [b]Go watch it! It will be worth it![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="XUyuqJ8PA3I;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]
Yes we have a release date! [/b]Set your calendars for the [b]6th of November[/b]! Finally you’ll be able to explore the wonderful and alien world of Sota7! So prepare your scientific tools, space suit and some headache pills (you’ll need them after cryosleep) and get ready to meet all of those fluffy (and some less so) animals. But survival isn’t all about the cute animals, to do so you’ll need to be prepared to look for drinking water, food sources and most important of all you still need to finish your important mission! [i]So be sure to read that debrief.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Meet our newest supporter![/b][/h2][p]
We’ve got some [b]BIG[/b] support from someone who all of you probably know! Please prepare a loud round of applause for [b]Nvidia! [/b]With them we’re able to provide you with Nvidia DLSS 4, RTX and RTXDI! I could bore you with all the details on how it works and what it will do to the game but why don’t you see it for yourself![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="03g1_q5f3JA;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
I must admit I got mesmerised by the water in that trailer! I know that your excitement is already through the roof but this Devlog is still far from over! Let’s move to the new stuff we’ve implemented to the beautiful world of [b]Honeycomb The World Beyond![/b][/p][h2]
Catch Us at Gamescom!
[/h2][p]One more thing! If by any chance you’ll be visiting Gamescom, be sure to check us out! We’ll have our own stand as part of the Indie Arena Booth, and you’ll be able to play a fresh, content-packed demo of Honeycomb before release. Expect plenty of new features to discover, some cool merch to grab, and of course, a chance to chat with the team!
[/p][h3]Let’s start with something that I absolutely adore![/h3][p]As you might remember some time ago we’ve added small critters to the game. I’ve already shown you a rat, a bat and some insects. This time our small guest took a bit longer to get here… I mean how can you blame him![/p][p]
[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfZg93DZe-ZBN29AsBeYV8sAu-jggwOuVFPuVszMmGRNLgjCVQkfA7gNTn1q4jv_CR7dcwnG1QDSEbBUjLN1jAbJoS6pu7QTjfXO2VYFSKsksASp9BRnhwAT0XzLOFHVxtwncMg?key=JJ4de-oDYx0zChoqfiSyXQ"][/img][/p][p]And while we’re on the topic of a hardy shell, please welcome the new addition to the big animals in the world of Sota7![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/3d4c453e237d195b6a8b401ae9059adefe4797d5.gif"][/img][/p][p]
This big ball of scales will be for you to discover in the world of Sota7, all I can share with you is its name - Nango!
[/p][p]Well, speaking of learning and discovering, we’ve decided to change a bit the way you’ll be discovering stuff in [b]Honeycomb: The World Beyond. [/b]Instead of using a lab centrifuge, you’ll need to craft yourself a handy scanner to catalogue all those handy (and some not so much) plants.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/d5baa2669266214401c13daa129dfb93332acdf2.gif"][/img]But the Scanner isn’t the only tech addition since last time! Perhaps you remember the drones that you’ll be able to fly around with. We have them ready to fly!
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c2aeadcf5a3c0fab8cfdd89345193b2fe60ead32.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/dee0e8f24b4d6b90f53441609ff7cd0cb7221ec4.png"][/img][/p][p]It wouldn’t be a complete Devlog without our favourite scientist heroine! Now with all the technology provided by [b]Nvidia![/b][/p][p]
And with that accent, I think it’s about time we’ve finished this Devlog for now…[/p][p]
As always, we hear you and we read everything you say in the comments. If you want more [b]Honeycomb: The World Beyond[/b], remember to join our social media. If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding [b]Honeycomb: The World Beyond[/b] to your wishlist and joining our [url="https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial"]Discord[/url]![/p][p]
 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb_The_World_Beyond/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Hive Update #12 - Climbing Closer!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Explorers![/h1][p][/p][p]Long time no see! Another month, another batch of information regarding Honeycomb: The World Beyond! Before we dive into the content of the Devlog, I invite you to join our stream! Jump onto our Steam Page and see the newest changes for yourself![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb_The_World_Beyond/"][/dynamiclink][/p][previewyoutube="MyX8GSd_H-U;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Have you enjoyed it? Good. Now let’s move on to the real content in this Devlog! [/p][hr][/hr][h2]Let’s climb to the best of content![/h2][p]I won’t bore you with the new changes to our technologies or the latest texture optimisation, but I can show you a bit of improvements and new additions to the game!

As the title suggests, we’ve added a new mechanic for you to use while exploring. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c788b8d4981b00946ffec534f0bd1421d85aa318.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]With this, we can give you some more means of vertical exploration in the world of Sota7.[/i]

While we’re still talking about exploration, let’s take a quick look at the tools available in your bioengineer arsenal. After all, your legs aren’t the only thing that you’ll need to explore…

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/86ea441a2b65332edb95a5916e841da3d9e82cab.gif"][/img][/p][p]Let’s move our attention to the new and redesigned station for your future labs! I won’t spoil you with the names of all the machines that you’re about to see, just to keep some of them for you to build when your turn to play comes, but let's be honest, we all remember what our multicooker used to look like!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/8f14c69c78ce3b573c90ac249d568cfe7e035182.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/e2a4ab9417c58a27325e164d6c52f360c2d8bc71.png"][/img]Continuing the topic of redesign and reimagination, let’s take a look at the light and other improvements to our map. Many small changes can contribute to significant transformations!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/77374e9fe963b51175165d9fbe7367733b3251ff.png"][/img][i]Who would have guessed that Sota7 would look so wonderful![/i]

Exploration goes hand in hand with resource gathering. We decided to upgrade that mechanic as well, adding some new VFX, so it feels more enjoyable to gather those highly needed metals or plants.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/d1c94748ff90fd3454b178dffea6e998f2877975.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]I do like those leafy effects!
[/i]

And lastly, on our agenda is something you haven’t been able to see in the stream (which includes some new content we haven’t shown in this Devlog) and with the new improvements, nights on Sota never looked so wonderful!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2db7536df2d7a93f43366a0fe8c5a216d65070b5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And lastly, it wouldn’t be a Honeycomb’s Devlog if we hadn’t included a Hennessy riding a hoverboard!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/d342ae03b5bef07bff98953fa482f6d2b942d976.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p]
As always, we hear you and we read everything you say in the comments. If you want more Honeycomb: The World Beyond, remember to join our social media. If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding Honeycomb: The World Beyond to your wishlist and joining our Discord!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/456a9f4bbbe96ff6d3ed5f22387f2601452373ca.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Until the next time!
~Dev Team[/i]

[/p]

notes.title: Honeycomb: The World Beyond GDC 2025 Trailer and Dev Log
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Explorers![/h2]

Must say it’s been some time since we shared some information about Honeycomb: The World Beyond with you. But today, that changes! We proudly announce that we’re ready to present you with a new trailer!

[previewyoutube=4JNb5pn_9dg;full][/previewyoutube]
After that warm welcome, let’s dive straight into the juicy content!
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Beauty of the Planet[/h3]

Last months have been very fruitful in all aspects of Honeycomb’s development. From the technical stuff to graphical changes and even the main story of the game(but let’s not get away with the spoilers).

Here’s a little screenshot straight from the in-game photo mode! Look how much Hennessy and the world around her has changed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/53ad2f941f4916fb00e3b2f49655e69854224f32.jpg[/img]

Those more observant of you might notice that the entire lightning has been improved a bit. In truth, we had to do it just so we could take more cool and dreamy scenes. Just like this one…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/e0e3c9f48cfcd07a1d1d748659deab7f5630d859.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Let’s just say our Concept Artists keep working on some amazing stuff…[/h3]

With the cat out of the bag - or should I say fireflies just above our hands - we also wanted to share with you some of the stuff we keep working on. Even though our team is working their hardest, they still manage to surprise us with the new things they’ve designed for the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/28c369894b7623e3866242659919e7c5eb6f165e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/5d0bf9d2e0d2473649ea5bcaf9918442cb75a6ae.png[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]It lives![/h3]

Trees won’t bring much life to the game unless we ensure that the entire world feels truly alive…

But don’t worry, we’ve thought it through! Now, Hennessy isn’t just focused on what’s beneath her feet - she also has to pay attention to what’s happening above. 

Additionally, as you approach animals, you can scan them to gather valuable information. But be careful - not all of them will be happy about it! Sometimes, you’ll need to find a way to gain their trust and get closer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/0d3f7676c58733b9cb33420cdd4afa7c9da2c6ef.gif[/img]
[i]And what is this mysterious creature?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/0937f2a7576c6893d7d30edf9c8c5e92f7f771c7.jpg[/img]
[i]Camilla! How’re you doing these days?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/aaa8eda5356025f80b0ee576b4acff334558f74b.jpg[/img]
[i]Look how beautiful the Amber Tree looks by the water![/i]

We’ve also wanted to thank you all for such a warm welcome at the GDC! We’ve heard so many warm words of support from those of you who have visited our stand, listened to one of our Dev’s presentation and watched the trailer before we’ve revealed it for all of our viewers!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/cc6cd5c3b0bb15a5794be07abd57b74fa1953eb2.jpg[/img]
[i]Just one more Hennessy for a better goodbye…[/i]

With that in mind we’ve arrived at the end of this Devlog. There’s still some road ahead of us before the release but the end is already clarifying itself for us. As always we hear you and we read everything you say in the comments. If you want more Honeycomb: The World Beyond, remember to join our social media. If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding Honeycomb: The World Beyond to your wishlist and join our Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png[/img][/url]

[i]Remember that Science is an art!
~Jacob and Honey Team[/i]

notes.title: Hive Update #11: Huge Publisher Changes!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Explorers![/h2]

We’ve been silent for some time, but the work has been going strong for the past few months. But it all came down to this important message…

[b]Please welcome our new Publishers with a round of applause![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/19dfd663a69a9b6edf239f6e58772330c96ea73c.png[/img]

We want to create something special and unique with our new friends at Snail Games USA. They’re the publishers of many incredible titles. But you probably know them most via ARK: Survival Evolved!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/346110/ARK_Survival_Evolved/

With that in mind, we would like to ask you for a bit more time to tie it all together before we publish a unique survival experience for you - our dearest players!

With the important stuff already out of the bag, let’s give you guys a quick development update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/7abda503b4e58a36e978c355d9ddd46d7a583c11.gif[/img]
[hr][/hr]
[h2]Let’s start with the usual…[/h2]

To kick things off, we wanted to show you something really cool! Here's a video made by one of our testers, where we're building a base. Base building is one of the key features of the game, and we can't wait to see your own creations!

[previewyoutube=hC7fXn-q8yw;full][/previewyoutube]

After your in-depth feedback about Hennessy, we decided to change her a bit.
From now on, you'll be able to place a mirror in your labs to change her hairstyle (don’t worry, we left her beautiful red hair in place).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/7ce9b971d688b458fa4fda288e790cd435cd7578.png[/img]
[i]She looks so much younger with longer hair![/i]

Next on our agenda are a bunch of new critters that will make the world of Honeycomb: The World Beyond even more alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b4c2e8ec4d0e720811e42934da7de782d1458f22.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/ea089a4272e1d3bd95a065c64d8cef456d073193.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/91978bd6a78e2c834115d37aa7e19fa0f92ec9db.png[/img]

Our concept artists are also hard at work with new projects that we could bring into the game. Here are a few new projects they’ve finished drawing in the last few weeks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/50a4f78b7481d1f09af6fb5825a1b313029d2400.jpg[/img]
[i]Artificial Nest[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/bd5ba68ec678ae41732aea66c6ce1c7d9e51140f.png[/img]
[i]What’s Honeycomb without bees? (And butterflies)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/42ca09523348410c04e9e222e9354f64dfab9a39.png[/img]
[i]Slime-like critters[/i]

In another quick peek, during the last beta test, we were able to gather a lot of feedback regarding the AR mode. From what we gathered, we decided to edit the effects to increase overall visibility within Sota7.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/39667171922db5efd5a10e79dc19a8cc0e70bc0d.gif[/img]
[i]Underground veins of ore were never so visible![/i]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]And here comes the time to say goodbye… At least for now![/h2]

If you want to see our team once again: Here’s a little summary of PAX West we attended at the end of Summer:

[previewyoutube=tWGqmpylRT8;full][/previewyoutube]

That wraps it up for today. If you want more Honeycomb: The World Beyond, remember to join our social media. If you don't want to miss any future Devlogs, consider adding Honeycomb: The World Beyond to your wishlist and join our Discord!

notes.title: POST NEXT FEST THANK YOU. WHAT'S NEW?
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Explorers![/h3]

Steam Next Fest has finally wrapped up, and wow, what a wild ride it was! On one hand challenging, on the other incredibly productive. We got heaps of useful feedback from you all. Today we just wanted to give a huge shoutout and say thanks for all your thoughts and ideas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b5d21f5c8cce7cc706f5155761e8b52520c83d09.jpg[/img]

Your insights helped us rework and update a few elements during the fest itself. As a thank you for being such an engaged community, we wanted to show you the improvements we implemented right after reading your suggestions.

Without further ado, let's get to the news.

[h3]CHANGES[/h3]

[h3]PIE MENU[/h3]

The first improvement we made based on your suggestions relates to the pie menu - we added a pop-up tutorial explaining this key interface feature. Since then, setting up the hotbars should no longer be an issue for you, but of course, this is not the final version of this solution. We are continuously working on it and hope that with your tips and suggestions, we will be able to show its final version in our next demo!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/68d0ba3fa6bbae6fea39cd0481c0ca923a4eaeb1.gif[/img][/list]

[h3]OVER-ENCUMBERED[/h3]

As for the carrying capacity, during the demo, we temporarily simplified this mechanic. Hennessy will still stop moving if she is over-encumbered, but in the current demo, we've increased the size of the notification that informs about this. Additionally, as per survival game standards, managing your inventory is part of the challenge load of the inventory is crucial because it limits the number of items that can be collected and carried. Therefore, we decided on a temporary compromise regarding the main character's load (e.g., when carrying very heavy ore) and opted to change the weights of some items. This system will still be improved, and we will definitely keep you updated in the upcoming devlogs! 

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/5712ab06d480198a09e21a26e3ee5038c07e645d.gif[/img][/list]

[h3]CRAFTING[/h3]

From building your base to crafting essentials and exploring the unknown – your feedback has been invaluable! We've fine-tuned the crafting times for items and buildings to make the process more fun and balanced. We adjusted the crafting time on the fly during the demo, and are now working on a more permanent solutions - one of them being a time skip option Thanks for helping us make the game better!

[h3]BLOOM AND MOTION BLUR CHANGES[/h3]

Some of you mentioned that the bloom and motion blur options in our demo caused significant discomfort, such as motion sickness and disorientation, forcing you to stop playing the game entirely. Your well-being is very important to us, so we’ve taken this feedback to heart and made significant changes to enhance your experience. From now on, if you prefer to play without bloom, you can completely turn it off with the on/off toggle. For motion blur, we've added an intensity slider, allowing you to dial it down to zero if you prefer. This should help anyone who found these effects problematic, making for a smoother and more comfortable gameplay experience. We hope these new options make your gameplay even better!

[h3]EXPLORER MODE[/h3]

And now, something for those of you who like to explore the game at your own, relaxed pace. We've been watching how you play and noting what you've enjoyed and where you've encountered challenges. If you're someone who wants to dive into the story and discover the world on your own terms, we're crafting a brand-new gameplay experience just for you. We call it Explorer Mode, and it's going to be here for those of you who prefer a more laid-back experience. We can't reveal all our secrets, but we can't resist giving you a tiny spoiler! You might even get to test this mode around the next Next Fest. Please let us know what you think!

[h3]SNEAK PEEK[/h3]

Pssst: we've got something exciting in the works! We’re working on our animals and their reactions; they will now sniff out Hennessy’s drones and react to unfamiliar tech. Some creatures might find it intriguing and stay calm, while others might see it as a threat and get aggressive. Take a look at what we're developing and share your ideas on how these animal interactions could evolve!

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c438f8d1aac965761981a28782a58df8baf9fa05.gif[/img][/list]
[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/fb4642c137b638b494962c6a548f7eb56d120d4b.gif[/img][/list]

[h3][b]KEEP UP TO DATE [/b][/h3]

That wraps up our summary of Steam Next Fest. Once again, we're extremely grateful for all the support you've shown us and for the valuable feedback you've provided. Your input has had a real impact on the game, and we've made changes right after analyzing your suggestions. Once again, a big shoutout to all of you, Explorers!

If you enjoyed the demo or are curious about the game's future development, we invite you to follow our upcoming devlogs and add Honeycomb: The World Beyond to your wishlist. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb_The_World_Beyond/

As always, we encourage you to follow us on social media for the latest updates. If you want to join our community and stay in close contact with the developers, hop onto our official Discord server.

[list][url=https://discord.com/invite/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f33a0a74f4f822167c42e3e6a197eb5b0b730df9.png[/img][/url][/list]

[i]Science is an art!

Fufu and Honey Team~[/i]

notes.title: Explore biomes and meet the life forms that have been discovered so far on Sota7
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello, Explorers![/b][/h3]

Before we start this devlog for real, we have hot news for you straight from Sota7. We’ve just launched our Honeycomb gameplay live stream! Make sure to visit our Steam page and see how two developers from our team fare against the challenges of our planet. And that's not all! If you'd like to play the Honeycomb demo, we are currently at Gamescom in Cologne till August 27th. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/d89bd8b8d4ba1a877480ccb571f371926f781fba.png[/img]

Swing by for a high-five and some potential feedback. We'll be waiting for you at the Hall 10.1 E028. Until then, fellow explorers!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb

Alright, now that we've got the news segment behind us, without further ado, I invite you for a short stroll!

Remember our last devlog? The one where we showed you what the vast and unexplored lands of planet Sota7 might look like? Well, today we have something special in store for you. Put your walking shoes on, because we're going on a little stroll. 


[h3][b]ANIMALS[/b][/h3]

Sota7 isn't just about stunning landscapes, it's also home to a variety of life forms. From the tiniest, like zuma, who made an appearance in the previous devlog, to the larger and more menacing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/89fd175a40c14adce364b94f4733e317746e6037.gif[/img]

In our Gamescom demo (available only at the event), you can encounter adorable woxes, striders, and the universally charming camillas, who mimic the behavior of others. They seem interested in Hennessy as well. Who knows, maybe they’d like to accompany her on her journey?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1a62f18b10094dffe62c50d0e7702c5c1228e8a5.gif[/img]

Hennessy is sure to meet other interesting animals on her journey - take for instance these woxes. These nimble little creatures thrive in an aquatic environment and they don’t like being disturbed. Let’s hope they get along - they will have to share the planet, after all. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/d546874bab3f405dfd8f6f033294c5e9c888f7d7.gif[/img]

[h3][b]OUR WORLD[/b][/h3]

As we take those first steps on Sota7, remember it's an uncharted planet. There are all sorts of wonders of Mother Nature waiting out there. Its flora and fauna will surprise you time and time again.

We previously unveiled the concepts for Stem Sanctuary, Nenu Grove, and Ash Woods. Now you can see what they look like in-game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/ea2b465fa4ba59b3f17bf46cabe3cb0fed96b5dc.gif[/img]

We've added a day and night cycle as well, so now you will be able to experience a living world in both sunlight and moonlight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/7962580bf8cda0c9c07931f10d37147183933977.gif[/img]


[h3][b]RESOURCES[/b][/h3]

Roaming an uncharted planet comes with its own risks, so proper preparation is key. Building a base of operations will be necessary if you want to survive. You will need a good amount of resources to make that possible. Sota7 is replete with various materials, which are there for the taking... or are they? Sometimes, you've got to dig deeper, and that's where our trusty trowel comes into play, helping you unearth those buried minerals!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c99657740dbf2adec6b29801ee45e753d2b8942d.gif[/img]

As a bioengineer you can also graft plants onto other plants by using the branch-cutting scissors. The scissors can be used to cut fruits and vegetables as well – now that's what you call a useful device!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b6b1743a6e36893a3901763a6ef972b15deed592.gif[/img]

[h3][b]UI/UX[/b][/h3]

Alright, let's get technical for a moment. A game can't function without an interface. We're constantly prototyping different versions and today, we wanted to give you a brief glimpse into the creation of a possible inventory interface, where you'll find all the materials you've gathered.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/8cd26ca594549d5c28fb464eabaf6b1099a89241.gif[/img]

[h3][b]STATUS EFFECTS[/b][/h3]

Continuing our journey through the interface, a crucial element for knowing what's happening in the game is status effects. First and foremost, we need to look after Hennessy’s health, which is represented by icons for hydration or dehydration, hunger or being full, and various energy levels.
During her adventure, Hennessy might also get injured - either by her own carelessness or territorial life forms. It’s important to take care of Hennessy’s health - after all, she’s out there on her own.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/e67bf484694bb3dab06a158a19d2cdb9e127d608.png[/img]

[h3][b]KEEP UP TO DATE[/b][/h3]

That's all for today's devlog. We hope you enjoyed our materials and we're eager to hear your thoughts, so please share them with us in the comments.

Keep an eye on our social media channels to stay in the loop, and make sure to hit that follow button and add Honeycomb to your Steam wishlist to stay on top of all the latest game updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb

If you'd like to catch up on our exclusive content, we also invite you to join our Discord, where you'll find the link in the banner below. See you there!

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/07ff714fc43946cf6d30c4e11921680769b0e7fe.png[/img][/url]

[i][b]Science is an art!
Team Honey~[/b][/i]

notes.title: Delve into the unknown – see how we shape the world of Sota7 in our Devlog #6
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Explorers![/h3]
 
Today, we’re excited to take you on a short journey through the uncharted territories of the planet Sota7. Zuma is ready – are you?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/58ccce9bfea9b18c06f016bd9a3dca6cf67613d7.gif[/img]

What potential dangers and mysteries await us in this unknown land? 
Today, we will unveil some of the secrets hidden within this new world and give you a glimpse of what lies behind the curtain.

So far we’ve only shown you the rough map sketches and blockouts. Now we're pumped to give you a sneak peek of the actual spot where the adventure's gonna go down.

A lot of effort goes into crafting an entire world – and even more into making it fun to traverse. Drawing inspiration from different media and real-life phenomena, our concept artists work tirelessly to create unforgettable places for your adventure on Sota7.

[h3][b]Nenu Grove[/b][/h3]

This quiet place was inspired by mangrove forests and Japanese gardens. Combining the wild overgrowth of mangroves that occur primarily alongside the equator with a more manicured appearance of Japanese gardens, this region is the only one of its kind on the map. With a giant waterfall at its heart, it shouldn’t be too difficult to find – just follow the river upstream! The challenge lies in evading its dangers and staying under the radar. The local fauna can be far from friendly. Another curious thing – for an area this resemblant of tropical regions of Earth, this place sure feels a little colder than what you’d expect…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c6ee760ab5ded40bbb0452bc5675c9640d2888e0.png[/img]

[h3][b]Ash Woods[/b][/h3]

The intimidating basalt pillars surrounded by volcanic sand tower over the entire area, casting a stark shadow on the lush grass. Against the dramatic backdrop of a blue sky and plantlife thriving thanks to the fertile soil, they create one of a kind environment for water-loving creatures. The surrounding waters are way warmer than they appear - and one can only wonder what mysteries are carried within their currents. Dark sandy beaches neighboring these woods were inspired by the volcanic beaches of Iceland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/c57e8d266b0658db00f43328b422e05e60cbee41.png[/img]

[h3][b]Stem Sanctuary[/b][/h3]

A deep sense of calm envelopes this quaint corner of Sota7. The trees here might look familiar, but scientifically they don’t have much in common with bamboo. Sometimes their lightweight trunks form a seemingly impenetrable wall, isolating it from the entire world. It’s a sanctuary for more than one reason - not only does it have a uniquely serene atmosphere, predators seem to steer clear of it. This makes it a safe haven for prey animals that inhabit Sota7 - expect to see a lot of friendly snouts… After they’ve warmed up to the visitor from the stars.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/97753a462b04f6dbf63dca9d62ed257df3b38aa3.png[/img]

[h3][b]Biome Design[/b][/h3]

Designing a world is a complex and challenging task that requires developers to engage in a multi-layered and multifactorial creative process. To illustrate this process we’re going to use a timelapse of three distinct biomes as they rose from the blank canvas and evolved into regions that you will get to explore in-game..

We begin by shaping the landscape on the map blueprint. Here, we gradually transition into the creative process and can start sculpting the terrain, creating rivers, lakes, or mountains - nothing is impossible.

Next stage is to place simple models of rocks, mountains, stones, and cliffs that will be exchanged for more detailed ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/ddb371328476e9b4a276fa2ff3d8d0cab898b807.gif[/img]

To make the world vibrant, we add grass and diverse trees to create different environments like forests and meadows. Game designers and concept artists design the plants, trees, and flowers, while 3D artists create and texture the models based on these designs. These models are then scattered throughout the world for a realistic look.

Our goal is a consistent and unified design throughout the entire world, optimizing for smooth gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/95085732757f126ec77965961bd246768ca4fc43.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Air Pollution[/b][/h3]

In the undiscovered world of Sota7, dangers lurk not only on the ground but also in the very air you breathe. Take heed and ensure your character's well-being, as neglecting them can have dire consequences. This toxic fog makes you extremely dizzy - and if you aren't careful, you might end up passed out far away from the safety of your base... Take care to prepare appropriately before venturing out. Oxygen is non-negotiable! Stay vigilant, for your survival depends on it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/45f71b2c541a715818bc97ce646f9b7a6be564c7.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Hoverboard[/b][/h3]

Moving in such diverse terrain can be more challenging than it seems, so we came up with a way to make it easier. To replace walking and save time, we decided to introduce the Hoverboard into the game. Not going to lie - the cool factor was a thing. We couldn’t resist a bit of “Back to the Future” flavor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2ec422040af15d12964537f59b098ff3b1cfa5eb.gif[/img]

[h3][b]New sky[/b][/h3]

As we embark on our mission to infuse our world with lifelike weather, we’re aiming for gradual implementation. Our focus starts with the sky itself! We invite you to witness the transformation of the clouds as they shift and evolve. Observe the interplay of light and shadow, the formation of different patterns, and the dance of atmospheric phenomena. Your feedback is very important for us, so please take a moment to share your thoughts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/8ec411a4324ed99d49b2717d1baccb840c28c66e.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Keep up to date[/b][/h3]

Well, that's all for today's devlog, explorers! Now you have delved deeper into the mysteries of our world, unraveling its secrets bit by tantalizing bit.

We hope you feel the rush of adventure as much as we do when we bring you new content. As always, we invite you to wishlist us on Steam and also follow our social media channels, or visit discord server to stay updated.

[url=https://discord.gg/frozenwayofficial][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/07ff714fc43946cf6d30c4e11921680769b0e7fe.png[/img][/url]

Science is an art!

Honey Team~

notes.title: Honeycomb Dev Update #2 - Gather, Build, Survive with release on Q4, 2023!
notes.content:
[i][b]Hello, fellow Explorers![/b][/i]

It’s been over a month since our last update, and we’re back with unexpected [b]NEWS[/b]! We’d like to announce that [b]The Honeycomb will release in Q4 of 2023![/b] If that isn't enough, we also want to share a fresh and new [b]trailer[/b] that is all yours!

[previewyoutube=sz3HEFO5Sdc;full][/previewyoutube]

However, before we go any further, it’s time for the second announcement of a crucial matter. [b]Honeycomb Official Discord Server is NOW LIVE![/b] If you've ever felt like joining the community, we think this is the time. We always wanted to connect people and create a place where they could discuss our game and become closer to us. We’ve thought sharing our concepts and development stage through the Discord server is a first-class idea. Furthermore, we wanted to invite you to take part in making the game. We want to hear your voice quicker than before.

So, what’s left is to click the banner below and say hello, because you're all welcome!
[url=https://discord.gg/hc-official][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2c5f576adc788405058c37c8d085ce7b1720f027.png[/img][/url]

[b]Steam Page News[/b]

Moving ahead, we have another BIG NEWS. As you may know, we’re constantly in the development phase, and it’s consuming most of our time. During last month, we challenged ourselves to redesign our entire steam page: starting from a capsule through descriptions to the screenshots. So, take a look at the new capsule, and feel free to join us by clicking [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/]HERE[/url] or  on the graphics below, and share your opinion of how you find the changes in the comments.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/7f5f6e5ea17fd69e2a7091452f7e71a234c8b735.png[/img][/url]

Without further ado, let’s get to the building, shall we?
In this devlog, we’d like to introduce you to our base mechanics. That also includes our inspiration for its style, some aspects you can use during the planning mode, and much more. Are you ready? Then let’s go!

[b]INSPIRATIONS[/b]

As we’ve mentioned in the last development update, our game is set in the distant future, and the Earth is going through an Eco–Apocalypse. That’s why we’ve wanted to create a unique style for our buildings. We’ve decided to mix classic sci-fi and the early XX century french design, Art Noveau. We’ve thought that those two opposites will create the perfectly combined style, where high-tech and domination of floristic details will show humanity yearning for nature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/487f67797ba79ec24dc1d4d860f345ae539632b5.png[/img]

[b]PLANNING MODE[/b]

The planning mode is something fresh and new. As you can see, it allows you to plan your base - structures locations, possible connections and all modifications. Apart from that it gives you all the information about the building process (f. ex. Building order, time) and resources that are required to build it. The hologram shows you what it’ll look like when it's ready so that you can design your dream base

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/300b04b6ab8234f6aa9647c837fbf05c869908be.gif[/img][/list]

[b]THE CREATION[/b]

Ready with your resources? Now you can sit, watch, and trust the process. That’s the power of automated building.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1f4dca0e45c8424ea8ae29916f3cd5e8445f260d.gif[/img][/list]

The base is not the only thing you can plan and have built automatically. We still work on different parts of the design, such as doors, stairs, windows, or furniture.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/1a520851ed89223e32836fd6dbf3a1443ecc78bd.gif[/img][/list]

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/57479c7cbc978b1605cb4c8cfc08cb14014e496f.gif[/img][/list]

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/f5012826485d70718ee0d802d48482f6c49b35c8.gif[/img][/list]

You can click the video below if you'd like to dive into a more detailed analysis of our inspirations for the style, planning mode, and automated building. Our devs, Bartek and Marko, will be pleased to know that you’ve checked it out.

[previewyoutube=TcDFwHe4Wwk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]FEEDBACK NEEDED[/b]

Because our creations are significant to us, and we believe you deserve a part in their development, [b]we need your opinions and feedback, Explorers.[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/b32f8b296b6d890c5adfaaa9195aa7d06b967763.png[/img]

We'd like you to share your thoughts about our planning mode and automated building process. Have you ever seen something like this before? 
We'd also want to know what possibilities, as a player, you can see while looking at these mechanics. 
Your ideas are much anticipated, the comment section is yours!

[b]KEEP UP TO DATE[/b]

As additional info, we’d like to announce that we’ll participate in PGA – Poznań Game Arena. If some of you don't know, that’s a polish gaming event in Poznań between the 7th-10th of October. You can visit us there, say hello and play our first ever build for players. We’re also wondering how many of you we’ll meet, so let us know.

So, that would be it for today, guys. We hope that you liked our base-themed devlog so as the big announcements. We'd like to remind you, that Honeycomb will release in Q4 2023, so stay tuned. We also want to invite you to join our Discord Server once again to stay with us closer than before. You can also check our social media to keep up with the date.

Last but not least, you can add Honeycomb to your wishlist as well as follow the game if you want to get notifications about future updates.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1510440/Honeycomb/

PS: Explorers, here’s a little sneak peek for you! Your opinion about the cooperation mode in Honeycomb would be an asset, so let us know, what you think.

[list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39978845/2019f35a7aafcf4734d016d4908acc90bfdaed6c.gif[/img][/list]

~Team Honey
